notes: A public-API translation of the native-green 123-assertion HLA_EVOKED three-member default-source regional attribute restore case. An ordinary object registration yields a default source region; two adapter-configured regional subscribers each receive the saved timestamped update after independent Flush Queue Requests. Post-save Retract terminalizes the original designator; restore recovers both pending copies and live retraction state. The callbacks preserve value, tag, producer, timestamp, empty but supplied region designator set, designator, grant times, and ordering; later Retract notifies both recipients. Isolated C++ primary/contract passed using only installed 2026-10-20 package libraries with integer64 and float64 time. The adapter supplies provider libraries, endpoint, IEEE 1516.2-2025 DDM FOM, object class, attribute, two dimensions, logical-time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback model. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, HLA_IMMEDIATE, durable/process-boundary restore, interoperability, and conformance are unverified.
